lines: Sab kahan, kuchh laala-o-gul mein numayan ho gayin
couplets.en: Only a few faces came to light in the tulips and roses.

lines: Khaak mein kya sooratein hongi ki pinhan ho gayin
couplets.en: What faces must lie hidden in the dust?

lines: Khaak mein kya sooratein hongi ki pinhan ho gayin
couplets.en: What faces must lie hidden in the dust?

lines: Joo-e-khoon aankhon se behne do ki hai shaam-e-firaaq
couplets.en: Let blood stream from my eyes on this evening of parting.

lines: Main ye samjhoonga ki shamein do farozan ho gayin
couplets.en: I will imagine that two candles have been lit.

lines: Neend uski hai, dimaagh uska hai, raatein uski hain
couplets.en: Sleep, peace of mind, and the nights themselves are his.

lines: Teri zulfein jis ke baazu par pareshaan ho gayin
couplets.en: Your hair has fallen loose across his arm.

lines: Ranj se khoogar hua insaan to mit jaata hai ranj
couplets.en: Grief wears away as we grow accustomed to it.

lines: Mushkilein mujh par padeen itni ki aasaan ho gayin
couplets.en: So many troubles came my way that they grew easy to bear.

lines: Yoon hi gar rota raha Ghalib to ai ahl-e-jahaan
couplets.en: People of the world, what if Ghalib goes on weeping like this?

lines: Dekhna in bastiyon ko tum ki veeraan ho gayin
couplets.en: You will see these towns laid waste.
